description: She wears a substantial opaque reddish burgundy gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a full skirt reaching the ground. Gold patterned trim follows the neckline, vertical bodice seams, cuffs, belt and hem. Round gold brooches sit at the shoulder straps and a round decorative gold buckle marks the waist. An ivory woven wrap with gold and burgundy borders rests loosely around the arms and hangs at both sides. Decorated brown closed shoes are visible beneath the central skirt opening. Small gold earrings and a simple ring complete the outfit. The cloth has a textured softly lustrous appearance; exact fiber is uncertain.
